metadata.description: Fifteen security and quality controls that actually hold in your repository, and one command that proves which ones do.

plugins.name: control-register
plugins.description: Make your repository refuse commits carrying secrets, install dependencies frozen and get upgrade proposals for them, block on lint, types and tests at every locus, and protect its default branch — then verify all of it against what GitHub actually enforces. One command reports which controls hold and which cannot be checked.
